newsitem.title: USA: Libbey to buy Vitro tableware stake.
newsitem.headline: Libbey to buy Vitro tableware stake.

text.p: Libbey Inc., the biggest glassware manufacturer in the United States, said Monday it agreed to invest $100 million for a stake in the glass tableware business of Vitro SA, the largest glassware maker in Mexico.

Toledo, Ohio-based Libbey said that under the deal, it would become a 49 percent owner of Vitrocrisa, Vitro's glass tableware business in Mexico, and would also buy Vitro's WorldCrisa, a supplier of flatware, dinnerware and other tabletop products to the U.S. foodservice industry.
The pact also calls for Libbey to distribute Vitrocrisa tableware in the United States and Canada and for Vitrocrisa to distribute Libbey products in Mexico, Central and South America.
The deal is subject to approval by regulators and other conditions. It is expected to close in the second quarter, Libbey said in a statement.
